metadata.title: Clicked like my brain went AFK and somehow landed a 1-shot? Valorant just cursed logic
metadata.description:
Me: clicking like I’m allergic to aiming
Enemy: probably uninstalling on the spot
How did this even happen? Still confused but I’m cashing in
Click if your aim ever decided to ghost but still got the job done!

Hit like if your aim ever just quit but still popped someone!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
